name: Ground Floor
summary: An art-deco lift whose floor dial counts down as the file loads, then dings and opens on your file
about: Ground Floor turns a download into a lift ride. Press the brass call button and the car comes down from floor 12 while a spring-loaded needle ticks across the dial, the floor plaque flips and light flashes in the door seam at every floor. At the ground floor the lantern dings, the doors slide open on a warm-lit car and the file steps forward with a tick.
how: Press the call button (or focus it and press Enter or Space).
The needle sweeps from 12 to G with the progress; the plaque, percent and MB update at each floor.
Press the button again on the way down to cancel the ride.
At G the lantern dings, the doors open on the file with a tick, then they close and the dial swings back to 12.
